chunks: And Ghiyāth ibn Ibrāhīm narrated from Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from his father عليه السلام, who said: ʿAlī عليه السلام said:
There is no harm in salam with a known measure and to a known term, and it is not to be contracted to threshing or harvesting.

key_terms.أَجَلٍ: A fixed term or deadline for delivery.
key_terms.السَّلَمِ: A forward sale contract in which payment is made in advance for goods to be delivered later.
key_terms.بِكَيْلٍ: By a measured quantity; indicating that the amount must be specified.
key_terms.حَصَادٍ: Harvesting; another uncertain event-based term disallowed in this contract.
key_terms.دِيَاسٍ: Threshing; an uncertain seasonal event that cannot serve as a proper contractual term.
key_terms.مَعْلُومٍ: Known and clearly defined, removing ambiguity from the contract.

ai.seo_question: Is a salam contract valid if its term is linked to harvesting or threshing?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling on the validity of a salam sale: the quantity and the deadline must both be clearly specified. It also prohibits tying the contract's delivery time to uncertain agricultural events such as threshing or harvesting.
